_comment: Repos worth checking first when searching for an existing skill. The ranker in scripts/find-skill.ts boosts hits whose origin starts with one of these; the model checks them before an unknown personal repo. kind: plugin-marketplace = installable via `claude plugin marketplace add`; skills-repo = SKILL.md dirs, install via vendor-skill.sh or `npx skills add`; spec = the standard itself.

sources.note: Anthropic's own examples plus skill-creator, the document skills, the template and the spec.
The `npx skills` CLI itself; skills/find-skills is the upstream twin of this skill.
Vercel's published skill set — the highest-install source on skills.sh.
Also shipped as superpowers@claude-plugins-official. writing-skills is its authoring reference.
Azure and Foundry skills; microsoftdocs/agent-skills is the docs-side sibling.
Codex-side plugin set; mirrors several Claude Code skills verbatim.
Upstream of pstack, which cc-millz re-publishes as a git-subdir source.
TDD, code review, grilling, domain modelling, writing-great-skills.
brainstorm, planning, review, thinking-tools, workflow, skill-eval.
The marketplace this plugin ships from. A general-purpose tool belongs in a plugin here; a project-specific one belongs in the project's own layer directories.
skills/ holds context7-cli and find-docs. The ctx7 skills subcommands are deprecated — use the MCP server instead.
MySQL and schema skills; the highest-install mysql skill on skills.sh.
Postgres, auth and edge-function skills from the vendor.
The Agent Skills open standard (agentskills.io) that Cursor, Copilot, Codex and Gemini CLI implement. Read it when a vendored skill's frontmatter looks unfamiliar.
